title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
abstract: arXiv:2607.21570v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for medical education, but most existing systems focus on localized interactions such as question answering or single-turn feedback, rather than organizing an entire clinical case into a decision-centered learning trajectory. We introduce \textit{MedGame}, a framework that transforms static clinical cases into structured, executable storytelling games. MedGame uses a dual-engine design: a Medical Narrative Designer synthesizes case-grounded clinical storylines with states and decision nodes, while a Story Director converts them into dependency-aware multimodal orchestration plans rendered by our released interactive platform. We construct MedGame Bench, a 5,000-case benchmark and evaluation protocol for Medical Narrative Generation and Story Direction. translated_title: MedGame：由大语言模型赋能的医学教育叙事游戏化框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在医学教育中展现出巨大潜力，但现有系统大多局限于局部化的交互方式，如问答或单轮反馈，而非将完整的临床病例组织成以决策为中心的学习轨迹。我们提出了MedGame，这是一个将静态临床病例转化为结构化、可执行叙事游戏的框架。MedGame采用双引擎设计：医疗叙事设计器生成基于病例的临床故事线，包含状态与决策节点；故事导演则将其转化为具有依赖感知的多模态编排计划，并由我们发布的交互平台进行渲染呈现。我们构建了MedGame Bench，这是一个包含5,000个病例的基准数据集及评估协议，用于医疗叙事生成和故事执导任务。实验表明，针对特定任务的微调能显著提升开源大语言模型在MedGame Bench上的表现，并缩小了其与商业模型之间的差距。
tldr: MedGame提出双引擎框架，将静态临床病例转化为结构化的可执行叙事游戏以支持以决策为中心的医学教育，并构建了包含5000个病例的MedGame Bench基准，实验证明任务特定微调可显著提升开源大语言模型的表现并缩小与商业模型的差距。
